title: Ogham
html_source: Ogham was a very early medieval (4-10 centuries CE) alphabet used to write the early Irish language. Originally appearing as lines carved into rocks, you can write “Ogham” in Ogham like this: ᚛ ᚑ ᚌ ᚆ ᚐ ᚋ
